apps.name: Achilló
apps.subtitle: Guided Achilles rehab, by ear
apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription:
Quick ones now start from the watch with the phone locked: the phone keeps the next quick one rendered and ready, same as Barefoot PT and Hips.
A session that runs to the end while the phone sleeps is credited when you open the phone.

Phone taps have their own button in the session controls. They switch off the moment the watch picks up the session, and only pressing the button turns them back on.
On an Always On watch, the wrist-down view is now a plain ring and countdown, no glow.

Evening holds: the 2-minute wait before hold 4 is now your third doming set instead of dead time (doming runs 2 sets earlier, 1 here).
If a BFR morning gets cut short during the cuff isometrics, restarting now gives you just the rest of BFR, not the whole routine again.
A third Barefoot PT in one day is now stopped with "done twice today", as intended.
